decisions_made.decision: The trained baseline is the serving model; the Monte Carlo table is its fallback
decisions_made.rationale: models/registry.load_serving_forecaster prefers HistoricalBaselineForecaster and degrades to the simulated table for cells with no learned history. Live model_version reads 'seasonal_median_v1+simulated'.

decisions_made.decision: Operator endpoints are gated behind require_operator; conductor writes behind require_conductor
decisions_made.rationale: Section 15.3. Unauthenticated write access to live vehicle state was the highest-severity risk in the design.

decisions_made.decision: Model metrics are stamped SIMULATOR_PERFORMANCE_ONLY_NOT_REAL_WORLD_ACCURACY inside the artifact
decisions_made.rationale: Section 6.5 forbids quoting synthetic-label metrics as real-world accuracy. Enforcing it in the file rather than in a docstring means it travels with the model.

decisions_made.decision: Demo will be staged around the crowd band at the boarding stop, with a rehearsed disclosure of synthetic data
decisions_made.rationale: The forecast-at-your-stop screen is the only thing competitors do not do. Volunteering the synthetic limitation converts the main vulnerability into the conductor cold-start story.
